The Challenge

Leading in High School Athletics Is Hard. Doing It Alone Is Harder.

The job comes with big expectations and very little preparation. Most new athletic directors and coaches figure it out on the fly. You don't have to figure it out alone.

  • Pressure from every direction: administrators, parents, boosters, and athletes
  • Nobody in your building who really understands your job
  • Learning the role without a playbook or a trusted sounding board
  • Long seasons, late nights, and too little time to lead instead of react
About Jeffrey

An Athletic Director Who Coaches Athletic Directors

Jeff Roth knows what it takes to lead a high school athletic program — not from a distance, but from experience. As a former Division I athlete, high school coach, and current athletic director with over 20 years in the field, Jeff has lived every stage of the journey he now helps others navigate.

His coaching practice is rooted in the belief that great athletic administrators and coaches are made, not born. With the right mentorship, intentional development, and a structured plan for growth, emerging leaders can accelerate their trajectory and build high performing programs that last.

Jeff founded Roth Performance Coaching to give athletic directors and coaches a trusted partner who understands the unique pressures, politics, and passion of high school athletics.

How It Works

A Simple Path to Get Started

Three steps from first conversation to real progress.

01
Free Discovery Call

Reach out by email or the contact form and we'll set up a 30-minute conversation about where you are, where you want to go, and whether we're a good fit. No pressure and no pitch.

02
Roadmap Session

We map out your goals, your challenges, and a personalized plan built around your program and your season.

03
Ongoing Coaching

Weekly or biweekly sessions with clear next steps after every meeting, plus regular check-ins on your progress.

Core Programs
Athletic Director Academy
One-on-One & Group Coaching for ADs

A coaching experience built exclusively for current and aspiring athletic directors. Choose private one-on-one sessions for deep individual focus, or a small group for peer-driven growth and shared learning.

  • One-on-one or group format
  • Weekly or biweekly coaching sessions
  • Strategic planning & program management
  • Navigating administration & stakeholders
  • Building a culture of excellence

Coaches Leadership Lab
One-on-One & Group Coaching for Coaches

My Approach
"Leadership is a skill. It can be taught, developed, and sharpened with the right guidance."
Tailored to You

No two coaches or athletic directors face identical challenges. Every engagement begins with a deep understanding of where you are, where you want to go, and what's standing in the way. Your program is built around your specific goals — not a generic curriculum.

Rooted in Real Experience

Having spent 20+ years as an athletic director, former coach, and Division I athlete, the guidance you receive comes from someone who has been in the trenches — not a textbook. The challenges you face are ones Jeffrey has navigated firsthand.

Consistent, Committed Partnership

Most clients thrive with weekly or biweekly sessions — a rhythm that creates accountability, momentum, and real progress over time. This is a relationship built on trust, honesty, and a shared commitment to your growth.

Leadership as a Passion

Coaching leaders is not just a profession for Jeffrey — it's a calling. The energy, focus, and investment he brings to every client reflects a genuine belief that great leadership transforms not just programs, but students, communities, and futures.
